Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 의뢰를 실패한 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 숙소에 돌아가 쉬어도 되냐고 물어보았다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: After failing the quest, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> asks permission to return to the quarters and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、宿に戻って休んでもいいかと尋ねた。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 未能完成委托的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>询问是否可以回住处休息。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 未能完成委託的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>詢問是否可以回住處休息。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Après avoir échoué à la quête, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a demandé s'il/elle pouvait retourner à ses quartiers pour se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Nachdem sie die Quest nicht geschafft hatte, fragte <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, ob sie in die Unterkunft zurückkehren und sich ausruhen dürfe.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Después de fallar la misión, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> preguntó si podía regresar al alojamiento a descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: Após falhar na missão, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> perguntou se podia voltar para o alojamento e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: หลังจากภารกิจล้มเหลว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ก็ถามว่าขอพักที่ห้องพักได้ไหม
Data.UnitTalk_IND: Setelah gagal dalam misi, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> bertanya apakah ia boleh kembali ke penginapan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Sau khi thất bại nhiệm vụ, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hỏi liệu có thể về phòng nghỉ ngơi không.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: मिशन में असफल होने के बाद, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ने क्वार्टर में वापस जाकर आराम करने की अनुमति माँगी।

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: ก็ได้อยู่หรอก แต่ว่า…
แบบนี้เป็นไง?

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>, 토토와 함께 숙소로 돌아가서 쉬기로 했다
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> and Toto decided to head back to the quarters and rest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、トトと一緒に宿に戻って休むことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> et Toto ont décidé de retourner à leurs quartiers pour se reposer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> und Toto beschlossen, in die Unterkunft zurückzukehren und sich auszuruhen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> y Toto decidieron regresar al alojamiento a descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> e Toto decidiram voltar para o alojamento e descansar.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> และโทโทตัดสินใจกลับไปพักที่ห้องพัก
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dan Toto memutuskan untuk kembali ke penginapan dan beristirahat.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> và Toto quyết định trở về chỗ nghỉ để nghỉ ngơi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> और टोटो ने क्वार्टर में वापस जाकर आराम करने का फैसला किया।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Toto pecked at <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> as they started to leave.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: トトは、立ち去ろうとする<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>をつついた。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: Toto a picoré <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> qui s'apprêtait à partir.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Toto starrte <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> an, als sie gehen wollte.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Toto picoteó a <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> mientras se preparaba para irse.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: โทโทจิก <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ที่กำลังจะเดินจากไป ได้จ้องมองอย่างรุนแรง
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Toto đã cắn <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> khi nhân vật này định rời đi.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: टोटो ने जाने वाले <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> को चोंच मारी।

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> brightened up after receiving the potion.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、ポーションを受け取って喜んだ。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> s'est réjoui après avoir reçu la potion.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animó después de recibir la poción.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se animou depois de receber a poção.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> รู้สึกดีขึ้นหลังจากได้รับยา
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> menjadi ceria setelah menerima ramuan itu.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> vui vẻ hẳn lên sau khi nhận được bình thuốc.
Data.UnitTalk_HIN: पोशन मिलने के बाद <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> का चेहरा खिल उठा।
